Chapter 6717: Pushing The Tribulation

Chapter 6717: Pushing The Tribulation

“Boom!” An explosion attracted everyone’s attention.

They remembered Lord of Life and Death’s trial and looked up to see a golden tsunami crashing down upon her.

She endured numerous waves, nearly dying each time. However, her firm dao heart kept her upright. She re-created her body each time and polished her true fate.

She became strong enough to split the ocean in half. An immortal rhythm manifested around her - a sign of ascension.

The tribulation became increasingly violent, pulverizing her flesh to everyone’s horror. Anyone else would have been long dead but her light always returned during the dao search.

Eventually, her dao became resplendent. Immortals laws appeared slowly and wove a path from above.

Immortal energy descended and turned the area into paradise.

“It’s time!” Many rejoiced at her success.

It’s been a long time since the last immortal ascension. This was a perfect process for everyone to witness, from the preparation to the result. Spectators benefited from the event.

Now, the golden waves of tribulation only served to perfect her immortal dao and remove the life-death affinity. Her karma caused the unavoidable tribulation. By surpassing it, this karma would be gone.

“Boom!” Her dao fought back against the raging pulse, seemingly pushing up heaven and facing its wrath.

Visual phenomena appeared around her. She became a cosmic lord; a single thought was eternal. She gained control over many epochs in the river of time.

Time flowed toward her immortal dao before rushing for the future again. Her immortal radiance had a golden glow consisting of temporal essences. The river crafted her a new shell.

She resembled a stopping point for time before it could flow onward. This state of her left everyone in admiration.

They all saw how many times her body was destroyed before success. The agony couldn’t be overstated. Nevertheless, she was fearless against the unstoppable tribulation. Her dao heart didn’t waver once.

This determination helped her create a stronger body on top of understanding the immortal dao. Her efforts were rewarded, creating a unique golden immortal avatar.

“Go!” She didn’t stop there and formed a golden barrier, pushing the tribulation up.

Normally, others only defended themselves until the end of the tribulation. This was the wisest choice. However, she wanted to push back.

This seemingly angered the high heaven. Instead of subsiding, the tribulation grew stronger and became a waterfall.

Cracks appeared on her barrier. Some bolts made it through and spilled blood. Alas, she wanted to push this tribulation back to the high heaven.

This astounded everyone because despite her frail frame, she was more overbearing and courageous than anyone else.
